build_attach_storage_backend: build a HiCacheController with attach_storage_backend to enable KV cache persistence to a storage backend
create_detach_storage_backend: create a detach_storage_backend call to disable and clean up the storage backend at runtime
test_write_kv_cache: test the write method to back up KV caches from device memory to host memory
refactor_load_kv_cache: refactor the load method to load KV caches from host memory to device memory
summarize_prefetch_kv_cache: summarize the prefetch method that prefetches KV caches from storage backend to host memory
